name: softube-ts-snare-crack
description: Snare crack + fatness via the Softube Transient Shaper — the manual's snare recipe: PUNCH up WIDE with SLOW type (a slow punch fattens the attack), plus a touch of LOW-band negative SUSTAIN to kill the low ring/rumble, Clip ON to beef it. For a snare stem or snare-forward bus that needs more snap without going clicky.
intended_for: a snare stem (or drum bus where the snare needs more crack/body)
plugin_build: Softube 'Transient Shaper.vst3' (renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok-authorized — re-verify on a new machine)
notes: Manual: snare wants SLOW punch (fattens the attack) on WIDE; Clip ON beefs it. The LOW-band -2.5 sustain kills low ring without dulling the crack. Keep punch modest (≤+4) — pushed punch goes clicky/spitty (see the tighten lesson). Expect crest/PLR UP; QC with detect-mix-issues for over-shaping.
